vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: phy-founder-fundraising
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle is a purely informational resource providing templates and strategic guidance for startup fundraising and investor communications. It contains no executable code, data exfiltration logic, or malicious instructions, and its content (SKILL.md) is entirely consistent with its stated purpose of assisting founders.

llm.summary: This is an instruction-only skill providing templates and fundraising guidance; its requested footprint (no installs, no env vars, no code) aligns with its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name and description match the content of SKILL.md: templates, cadence, outreach, pitch/deck guidance and meeting scripts. The requested footprint is minimal (no binaries, no env vars), which is appropriate for a text/template guidance skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains only prose, templates, and procedural advice — it does not instruct the agent to read system files, call external services, or access credentials. Minor inconsistency: it references "references/narrative.md" and "founder-gtm skill" but those files/links are not included in the package; this is a documentation cross-reference mismatch rather than a security risk.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files are present (instruction-only), so nothing is written to disk or downloaded at install time. This is low-risk and proportionate for the skill's purpose. The OS restriction (darwin, linux) is unnecessary for a text-only skill but not harmful.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are requested. There is no disproportionate secret access for the skill's stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable; it does not request permanent presence or elevated privileges and does not modify other skills or system settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is essentially a toolkit of fundraising templates and playbooks and does not request credentials or install software, so it is internally coherent and low-risk. Before installing: (1) confirm the skill's provenance/author if you care about trust or attribution, because the package contains only SKILL.md and references some files/skills that are not bundled; (2) review and edit templates before sending them to investors (they are not legal/financial advice); and (3) if you allow autonomous agent invocation on your agent, note that although this skill has no broad privileges, you should still control when an agent can send messages or take actions on your behalf. If you want the missing referenced assets (e.g., references/narrative.md or founder-gtm integration), ask the publisher for the complete bundle or link to the other skill.
